name: scmjs-plugin-api-playground
description: API Playground — try the scmJS plugin API in the editor; a plugin for the scmJS StarCraft map editor.
author: Jeany

scripts.build: esbuild plugin.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --loader:.d.ts=text --alias:playground-api-types=./node_modules/@scm-js/plugin-api/index.d.ts --outfile=dist/plugin.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build - do not edit; the source is plugin.ts."
